name: agy-context-saver
description: Save tokens and prevent context bloat in Google Antigravity with RTK shell compression, bounded file reads, background polling protection, and fast CLI transcript search.
suggestedPrompts: Run agy-context transcript health to audit context health and token consumption for this session
Search this conversation's transcript for earlier tool errors using agy-context transcript query
Inspect recent conversation turns cleanly without raw JSON bloat using agy-context transcript read
